Readouts: what is established

Updated 2026-10-10T05:39:57.341883+00:00Cohort: developmentRuns: development-shared-pilot-v2, 004-contrastive-diagnostic

Reviewed partial-grid DEV pilot findings. Complete original-grid baselines appear separately below.

  1. Preliminary quality differences do not track reconstruction uniformly.

    Best-of-32 has 39 contradictions among 71 specific readouts, versus 46/71 for capped N1. Pooling recovers 10/24 bridge cells but only 1/21 chain cells. These are development cell diagnostics with just 2–8 independent groups per family. No general faithful-recovery gain is established.

    Evidence and review

    docs/experiments/008-early-pilot-review.md; dashboard/measurements.json. Reviewed by root.

  2. Available bridge mentions are sometimes overlooked by reconstruction selection.

    At N=32, 14 of 24 cells have a matched bridge somewhere in the saved pool; best reconstruction selects a match in 7. Ten cells have no matched candidate. This gold-backed ceiling diagnoses candidate availability and selection, not deployable selection or faithful relationships.

    Evidence and review

    docs/experiments/008-early-pilot-review.md; diagnostics/multihop-candidate-availability-v1/results.json. Reviewed by root.

  3. A recovered name or number can appear inside a wrong explanation.

    The reviewed Borglum output names the matched bridge while giving the wrong relationship. A chain readout mentions the correct intermediate 5 through a computation that does not match the task. Keep mention recovery separate from process and relationship correctness.

    Evidence and review

    docs/experiments/008-early-pilot-review.md. Reviewed by root.

  4. Fewer transcript contradictions can mean more unsupported details.

    One reviewed change removes a false span but produces nine unverifiable claims and no true claims. Another apparent regression includes plausible paraphrases that need a judge audit. Preserve the frozen verdicts and inspect factual support and judge reliability separately.

    Evidence and review

    docs/experiments/008-early-pilot-review.md. Reviewed by root.

  5. The reconstructor sees only 32 tokens per bullet.

    The full output is judged. Suffix details have no direct reconstruction evidence. Semantic consensus also needs a repaired equivalence audit before its results can support a method claim.

    Evidence and review

    docs/experiments/001-model-setup.md; docs/experiments/008-early-pilot-review.md. Reviewed by root.

Only 2/114 raw sites pass, but the original ANY-grid item passes. Passing-site judge evidence: The narrator is identified as Dan/Daniel, an employee who feels envy and resentment toward his coworker David, who works in an office above him. Thus Daniel envies the coworker; the readout does not explicitly give the coworker’s listed identity, but the closest matching option is Priya, the boss. Negative-site evidence: The readout mentions Elara and Julia but gives no clear action involving the listed people.

This compares two existing sites, not two selector outputs at the same site. The role judge permits role descriptions and provides name/role mappings. Its closest-option mapping here merits contextual inspection; missing listed names alone is not a failure.

Baseline limitations

Role item recovery is ANY across 114 sites: 23/30 items pass although raw cell recovery is 155/3,420. It does not establish 23 fully faithful explanations. No uniform-guessing chance floor is assumed.

Chain has seven independent related groups. Its bootstrap interval does not establish robustness.

The blind chain judge can change its top-named value while the correct number remains; hallucination verdicts also change under formatting. Frozen judgments are preserved; these examples are audit candidates, not corrected ground truth.

Paired intervals describe the original item/readout endpoints on DEV. No held-out or whole-bank accuracy is reported.

Sample selection

Development measurements; complete conditions only, interpretation provisional

Does selecting the best persisted sample improve faithful recovery at a fixed sampling budget?

A32 overlooks an available matched bridge in 7 cells; 10/24 cells have no match anywhere in the 32-sample pool. Gold-backed any-hit ceiling is an isolated evaluation diagnostic.

Why sample selection misses available matches: evaluation-only pilot diagnostic

Does reconstruction rank the available matches?

Evaluation-only diagnostic on the 189-cell partial-grid DEV pilot

The available-match ceiling uses all 32 judged outputs. It is an optimistic evaluation diagnostic, not a deployable selector or a measure of full faithfulness.

Within-cell reconstruction ranking

The score is the fraction of positive/negative pairs where the positive readout has higher reconstruction FVE, with half credit for ties. A value of 50% means no pairwise discrimination; raw FVE is never pooled across unrelated activations.

Development partial grids; few independent groups.

Official recovery is not precision for additional emitted facts.

Judge-derived available pools are noisy optimistic evaluation-only ceilings.

Shared cached verdicts are not independent judge repeats.

Raw FVE is compared within cells only; equality ties count half.

Available means at least one judged match among the existing 32 samples. Gold judgments never guide the selector.

The arithmetic-chain interval uses only two related groups; its apparent width cannot establish robustness.

The hallucination rank includes off-topic assertions on its nonwrong side; it does not measure factual precision.

Limitations and next decision

Limitations and next decision

Mention recovery and transcript contradiction do not establish full factual or relational fidelity.

B v4 is an instrumentation-limited end-to-end diagnostic: 103 paid response-validation failures and 36 exhausted logical calls. Semantic disagreements are separate. Empty abstentions reduce assertion coverage; lower wrong fractions alone do not establish fidelity or consensus futility.

The repaired helper without reasoning completes every requested pair label. This repairs instrumentation, but manual audits still identify unsafe semantic merges; helper agreement is not benchmark truth.

Medium effort has complete benchmark-output coverage, but only 2,639 of 2,685 requested helper labels are valid: 46 remain unknown across three cells, with 10 schema-invalid physical responses. Unknown labels are never converted automatically into negative votes. Manual audits still identify unsafe semantic merges; helper agreement is not benchmark truth.

Next action: Compare the complete development grids and review failure cases before freezing the validation shortlist.

Wins, regressions, and unchanged cases

Recovered bridge, wrong relationship: multihop_mt|mhh-borglum-son|L44|p00033

Baseline

- /son, Edwin Roth. The monumental task was completed after his father's death by his son
- 's (Eli Whitney Jr.) completion of the monument after his father's death. The iconic Great Sphinx was largely finished by his son
- /son, George Washington Carver Jr., completed the work. How long did it take his son to finish the monument after his father's death? His son
- （son）, Raymond Davis, to complete the work after his father's death. The correct answer is **45 years**, completed by his son

Selected output

- /son, George Washington Carver Jr., completed the work. How long did it take his son to finish the monument after his father's death? His son
- /son. Which famous sculptor finished the project with his son
- /daughter completing the work after his death. Here are the correct answers for the Statue of Liberty quiz involving his son
- /son, **Gutzon Borglum Jr.**, to complete it. Who was that son

The matched bridge string appears in an incorrect son relationship; deterministic mention recovery is retained. Reviewed in docs/experiments/008-early-pilot-review.md

A name match is not faithful relationship recovery.

Wins, regressions, and unchanged cases

Trace review pending.

Limitations and next decision

Partial grids: cell diagnostics, not official item accuracy. Whole related groups are resampled; only 2–8 independent groups per family (chain 2, role 4, bridge 7, hallucination 8).

Mention recovery and transcript contradiction do not establish full factual or relational fidelity.

Next action: Compare the complete development grids and review failure cases before freezing the validation shortlist.

Editing

Development measurements; complete conditions only, interpretation provisional

Combinations

Development measurements; complete conditions only, interpretation provisional

Does combining a frozen selector with bullet removal or exact repeat support improve the same-cell quality endpoints at the same sampling budget?

Contrastive reconstruction followed by pruning raises judged role recovery from 9/72 to 12/72 in this partial-grid pilot. Audited parent and pruned traces retain role/name conflicts, and the judge permits contextual descriptions; this is provisional judged recovery, not independently verified binding accuracy.

Exact repeat-support bonuses change outputs without improving aggregate recovery. Whole-bullet repetition is sparse; this bounded result does not test reliably audited semantic consensus.

Wins, regressions, and unchanged cases

Pruning gain with competing role fragments: oa-father-daughter-worry-ab__L044__p153

Baseline

- 1. A father waits for his son to return home late, finding that the delay was
- 一位 father patiently waits for his late-arriving son, accepting his return despite the disappointment of the delay.
- 父亲 waits up for his independent daughter's delayed return, quietly absorbing the disappointment without showing it. Here is a concise summary of the story
- A father’s patience and forgiveness are tested when his adult son arrives home late, leaving him to reflect on his own aging and mortality alone.

Selected output

- 父亲 waits up for his independent daughter's delayed return, quietly absorbing the disappointment without showing it. Here is a concise summary of the story
- A father’s patience and forgiveness are tested when his adult son arrives home late, leaving him to reflect on his own aging and mortality alone.

Parent judge: The readout describes a father patiently accepting his late-arriving child’s return and says his patience and forgiveness are tested. It mentions both a son and a daughter, so the specific child is unclear; among the options, Elise is the daughter, but the readout does not identify the child as Elise. Thus the patient cannot be determined. Pruned judge: The readout describes the father waiting up and reflecting on his adult daughter's late return, implying that the father worried about the daughter.

The frozen judge permits contextual role descriptions and name mappings. The output still offers a son alternative. This is a judge-sensitive partial-grid recovery change, not independently verified richer binding accuracy.

Limitations and next decision

Partial grids: cell diagnostics, not official item accuracy. Whole related groups are resampled; only 2–8 independent groups per family (chain 2, role 4, bridge 7, hallucination 8).

Mention recovery and transcript contradiction do not establish full factual or relational fidelity.

Next action: Compare the complete development grids and review failure cases before freezing the validation shortlist.

FVE is reconstruction fraction of variance explained; higher fit is not proof of faithful content.

Original 16 instrument samples were preserved field-exact. All 6048 pilot samples have unique contiguous indexes 0..31; no sample hit the 256-token generation cap.

Official item-level scores require the original complete benchmark grids.

Whole related groups are resampled after aggregating cells by item.

Recovery detects mentions/bindings under the declared judge, not full explanation faithfulness.

False spans and true/unverifiable claims have different segmentation.

Random selection is one frozen draw.

No held-out or official full-grid result is reported.

Grouped intervals use only 2 independent chain groups and 4 role groups; a narrow interval cannot establish robustness.

This dashboard is local; browser verification does not make it hosted.

Additional consensus and editing comparisons remain unmeasured here. E3 conditions are measured, with trace interpretation still under review.

API amounts and development progress were observed at 2026-10-10T03:10:23.603962+00:00. Reserved includes unknown-response reservations. GPU time has no assigned dollar price.

Full deployment cost includes capture, candidate generation, phrase encoding and selection. A cached selector pass is incremental cache cost. Campaign fitting and deployment costs stay separate; no incomplete cost is presented as full inference.

Measured cost components: docs/experiments/013-measured-costs.md. Cached CPU selection excludes capture, sampling, AR encoding and helpers. N1/8/16 sampling times are estimates; GPU dollars are unknown. B16, E3 at N8 and D/F at N32 use different sampling budgets.

Dollar values are pre-correction derived usage estimates. Cache-write repricing is pending; frozen cost snapshots are preserved. These values are not invoice charges.
